validDesktopEvidence.run: fresh static Tauri baseline before ByteView/base64 change
validDesktopEvidence.limitation: The run stalled after mount in a harness-only full Object.isFrozen check, before save/reopen/edit/conversion validation. The 0ms marker is mount discovery only; the true ready interval was not emitted.

validDesktopEvidence.run: fresh static Tauri run with ProjectByteView and base64 bridge
validDesktopEvidence.unrecordedDiagnostics: Harness custom storage/decode event listeners returned empty arrays, so native read time and end-to-end stage timings are reported directly; actualDocumentDecode is unavailable.

timingBoundary.editorWaitMeaning: 从 waitEditor 开始轮询句柄、等待宿主焦点恢复并完成两帧后的局部等待，不是从 workspace.open 开始的总耗时。
timingBoundary.editorDiscoveryMeaning: 等待函数立即发现已经挂载的输入和 driver；不是 React 完整挂载耗时。

stackSamples.observed: 709 main-thread samples; 691 were JavaScript microtask execution. 420 samples reached Object.defineProperty indexed-property insertion and SparseArrayValueMap::add/rehash.
stackSamples.interpretation: This matches the pre-ByteView copyBytesAsync loop that Object.defineProperty()'d every byte. It is direct stack evidence for that copy stage, not yet a post-optimization measurement.

stackSamples.phase: after TXT editor mount, before ready progress
stackSamples.observed: 959/959 main-thread samples were in JavaScriptCore Object.isFrozen -> testIntegrityLevel -> getOwnPropertyNames/Identifier::from. WebContent footprint was about 2.5 GB, peak about 3.0 GB.
stackSamples.interpretation: This confirms the harness's full Object.isFrozen(array) over 18,776,845 indexed entries caused the post-mount stall. The harness now checks only Object.isExtensible and first/middle/last property descriptors.

harness.frontend: Static Vite dist embedded in the isolated Tauri app; no dev server or HMR.
harness.repeatableReset: Refresh script syncs current src, packages/sdk, and src-tauri into temporary snapshots; run launcher rebuilds a temp SDK and frontend, checks TypeScript, builds the isolated native binary, resets only the temp project/app-data, and records stage progress.
harness.typescriptCheck: Passed on the final snapshot before launch; static frontend build and isolated native Cargo build also passed.
harness.launch: The first ordinary sandboxed launches stopped before native setup. The successful isolated GUI run used require_escalated; page visibility, document focus, and native window focus all reported true at each step.
harness.newProtocolHarnessChanges: Large TXT validation uses ProjectFile.byteView and copyTo samples; it never reads the novel legacy bytes getter or calls Object.isFrozen on the large array. Compatibility byte reads are restricted to small fixtures.

profileHarnesses.staticBuildsAndTypeChecks: Both passed before the profile runs.

notYetVerified: Separate read-only Array.from/Object.freeze versus chunked-copy contrast probe; it remains intentionally excluded from the product-path run.

nodeSuite.note: The remaining 12 failures match the independently reproduced pre-change HEAD baseline. The earlier concurrent-build launcher startup timeout passed in the final quiet full suite.

finalVerification.remainingPerformanceBoundary: The editor still emits full strings and the document adapter encodes whole UTF-8 buffers after edits. The controlled 48-event typing comparison measured a 44ms maximum frame gap after optimization; raw-save confirmation measured 41ms in a separate one-edit run. These are local measurements, not guarantees for every size or hardware.

method.application: Real Tauri desktop app with a static Vite bundle embedded in WebKit.
method.input: Synthetic DOM keydown/beforeinput/input/keyup events plus textarea range mutation; follows the mounted plain-text driver, documents workspace, document-file adapter and storage session path. It is not physical keyboard input.
method.foregroundGate: Before measurement, document visibility, document focus, and native-window focus had to remain true for 500ms. Native and DOM focus were checked after every event; a run losing focus was discarded and repeated after focus was restored.
method.inputStartIntervalBoundary: Includes the programmed 18ms wait and the per-event native focus query; use synchronous dispatch for editor work latency.
method.timingBoundary: Span timings are nested. Do not add parent and child spans; update total includes encoding, capture, validation, write notifications and subscriber work.

profileMethod.inputPath: synthetic DOM textarea keyboard/beforeinput/input events through the mounted Tauri driver/workspace/storage chain; not hardware keyboard input
synthetic DOM textarea keyboard/beforeinput/input events through the mounted Tauri driver/workspace/storage chain; not hardware keyboard input

optimized.measurementStage: Input-path optimizations before raw-byte saving. The later binary save change does not alter the measured input handler; its autosave results are reported separately.

comparison.autosave: At the input-only optimization stage, both variants saved successfully but autosave frame gaps did not improve. The later rawBinaryAutosaveProfile below records the separate binary-transport fix and its one-run-per-transport comparison.

interpretation: The self-built editor rendering and text-model getText spans remained small; the main baseline cost was the document callback/storage update path.
The optimized path reduced full-document UTF-16 validation to under the timer’s 1ms display resolution and avoided most same-file byte projection comparison work.
The optimized status-bar character counter used 1096 chunk tasks in the measured run; each task measured P50/P95/max 1/1/2ms, within its 3ms task budget.
The valid baseline sample was the retry after one attempt lost visibility at event 39; the lost attempt was excluded. The optimized sample completed on its first attempt.

harnesses.builds: Both TypeScript/Vite/native preflight builds passed before GUI profiling; each app used a separate embedded static frontend, native binary, project directory and app-data directory.

autosaveEncodeProfile.method: one synthetic DOM textarea input through the mounted Tauri editor/workspace/storage/native chain; not hardware keyboard input
autosaveEncodeProfile.interpretation: The synchronous desktopCommand startup measured 301ms and one JSON.stringify call measured 168ms, while encoding both buffers took 19ms and the native base64 handler took 275ms (252ms decode, 22ms file store). The probe did not preserve per-call JSON.stringify marker details, so the 168ms call cannot be conclusively identified as the save payload serialization; measure it again with the raw-binary bridge comparison before attributing that exact call. The save interval included the existing autosave debounce.

rawBinaryAutosaveProfile.method: one synthetic DOM textarea input through the mounted Tauri editor/workspace/storage/native chain; not hardware keyboard input

comparisonWithPreviousBase64Sample.interpretationBoundary: Single runs show the synchronous invoke and native frame work shrink substantially with the raw body. This is a focused confirmation, not a percentile benchmark; the overall save timer includes the autosave debounce.

binarySaveFunctionalE2E.kind: Real Tauri desktop functional E2E using the current frontend raw-byte save bridge and native Request body command; not a performance benchmark.
